version: v9 (2026-09-25, items 15-21): masonry terrace, mirrored floor, map_empty sheets, Guild Clerk, LARGER lower room, board on the back wall, no railing across the walkway
units: 1 unit = 1 dungeon-kit metre; cell = 4 units; y up; camera looks from +x,+z
placementRule: For each prop: scale uniformly so h (height) / w (width) / size (longest side) of the UNROTATED model bounding box equals the rule value (the measured `scale` is already given); apply stretch if present; rotate with Euler order YXZ (yaw applied last); then move the rotated bounding box so its centre is at (x,z) and its bottom at y (or its centre at yc). The knight is a skinned rig: measure its BONES (+12% margin), not its mesh box. NEW: some props carry `stretch` [sx,sy,sz] multiplying the uniform scale per axis BEFORE rotation (kit beams, floor strips); `tint` replaces the model materials with a plain wood colour.
sourceOfTruth: docs/product/art-direction/mockups/quest-hall-v8.template.html (behaviour) + this file (numbers, measured from that page)

miniature.what: The Map view WORLD level, shrunk onto the table. MUST come from the same pure functions the Map view uses (src/data/map-layout.ts: campaignBuildState, worldLayout/trailLayout, roadPiece, hexNeighborhood, terrainPlan + hash2, axialToPixel, colorForIndex, assetFileBase) and the same placement as src/views/map.ts (placeGround/placeStructure/placeRoads/placeTerrain: HEX_SIZE = 2/sqrt(3), tile at p*HEX_SIZE, tower scale .85 on a hex_grass tile, roads rotation.y = steps*PI/3, RAISED = stacked copies at y .5/1, hills/mountains get a grass base, rocks on 20% of grass). The mockup ports those functions verbatim into JS to prove the look; in the app REUSE them, do not reimplement.
miniature.data: the ledger's campaigns, in ledger order: pizza-fleet-mvp (IN_PROGRESS, blue) and pizza-fleet-expansion (IN_PROGRESS, green), joined by 2 road hexes
miniature.models: hexagon/hex_grass, hex_water, hills_A/B/C, mountain_A/B/C_grass, rock_single_A-E, hex_road_A/B/C, building_scaffolding, building_tower_base_{blue,green,red,yellow}, building_tower_A_{blue,green,red,yellow}
miniature.fit: group scaled by f = (tableWidth/2*.9)/R where R = farthest tile centre from the bounding-box centre + 1; group centred on the table top at y = tableTop + .02
miniature.notMirrored: labels, gates and click-to-drill are NOT in the miniature (mockup); the live app version should be a scaled Map scene (ask swe-map how to mount it) and may add the campaign tags
